svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Write one loader for each of the five sources in the interface view.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Give every identity value a default, so a repository with no

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: identity file still renders with the Design Molecule values.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. When a file cannot be read, stop with the file name and line;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: never fall back silently to an empty value.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Hand back one record. No other module opens these files itself.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the checker and the gate read the record (joint 1); the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: renderer, sheet generator and media renderer read its identity

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: run it on the 38 finished portfolio repositories; every

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: record matches what the present scripts read, field for field.
